summary: Six villagers, a Bonfire and 21 Veggies. Food runs out in about four days, so a Trappers' Hut comes immediately: it gives Meat and the Animal Hides behind the 18 Coats (54 Hides). Then bricks for two Tailors, whose Coats villagers also wear when cold, and a Quarry to clear the three rocks (30 Stone).

build_order.note: 4 Logs + 8 Sticks; 2 Meat and 1 Hide per catch.
Beds: six workers are the bottleneck, and births need free beds.
A second and third hut: 54 Hides for coats plus 15 in stock (optional).
Two needed, 12 Bricks each; 3 Hides make 1 Coat.
6 Logs; 'Clear all rocks' counts 30 Stone made.

pitfalls: Labour is scarcer than materials; staff only what the next objective needs.
Coats are Heat gear: cold villagers put them on, which eases the Bonfire's load early on. The objective counts Coats sewn, so worn ones should still count (to confirm in play).
source: Drafted from the decoded objectives, starting inventory, build list, construction costs and recipes (game data 30, build 254); not yet playtested. Checks for a test run are in docs/PLAYTESTS.md, Part C.
